rating_scale.0: absent or verified broken for required purpose
rating_scale.2: useful basic outcome with substantial verified gaps
rating_scale.3: expected use and important applicable boundary cases work, minor gaps
rating_scale.4: all defined checks satisfied with suitable evidence

criteria.name: Account request to first workspace
criteria.acceptance_checks: Synthetic registration, approval/invite/setup and first useful task; validation/duplicate/inactive-account checks.

criteria.name: Field job lifecycle
criteria.acceptance_checks: Synthetic tenant job create, read, edit, notes/material/time, completion/archive/restore; role and persistence checks.

criteria.name: Retail operations
criteria.acceptance_checks: Synthetic order/import/rewards/wholesale contract checks; invalid signatures, replay and store separation.

criteria.name: Shared customer, team and class work
criteria.acceptance_checks: Synthetic customer persistence, team messaging attachments, class enrollment/capacity and handoffs.

criteria.name: Persistence and validation
criteria.acceptance_checks: Reviewed feature tests exercise save/reload and invalid input in representative core tasks.

criteria.name: Retry and idempotency
criteria.acceptance_checks: Reviewed duplicate/retry tests for provider events, messages and payments retain one intended result.

criteria.name: Failures and health visibility
criteria.acceptance_checks: Observe public health and run history/failure contracts; errors must stay distinguishable from success.

criteria.name: Recovery and customer export
criteria.acceptance_checks: Restore a disposable MySQL backup and verify representative customer data export and recovery.

criteria.name: First value and approval guidance
criteria.acceptance_checks: Visitor understands request vs instant access; synthetic first-login/setup flow identifies useful next action.

criteria.name: Navigation and module discovery
criteria.acceptance_checks: Public links and filters work; canonical module visibility and authorized shell navigation have evidence.

criteria.name: Form feedback and recovery
criteria.acceptance_checks: Core invalid/expired/duplicate submissions produce actionable feedback; public controls are usable.

criteria.name: Daily home and search
criteria.acceptance_checks: Synthetic role-aware dashboard/search identify available next actions and suppress inaccessible content.

criteria.name: Tenant and object boundaries
criteria.acceptance_checks: Synthetic A/B tenant host, membership, object and mobile API negative tests; no real-record enumeration.

criteria.name: Role and financial boundaries
criteria.acceptance_checks: Synthetic member/manager/owner/landlord and financial-field negative tests for representative workflows.

criteria.name: Authentication and session controls
criteria.acceptance_checks: Synthetic login, registration, verification, reset, 2FA and signed/expired-token contracts.

criteria.name: Sensitive data and integration gates
criteria.acceptance_checks: Synthetic secret/private-field, unsigned-webhook and disabled-provider/host checks.

categories.name: Clarity of purpose, audience, and customer value

criteria.name: Purpose, audience and brand
criteria.acceptance_checks: Public platform and parent explain business outcomes; demos are labeled and product families are not falsely conflated.

criteria.name: Prices and package promises
criteria.acceptance_checks: Homepage, plans, start and explorer agree on seat limits, included modules, add-on prices and offer terms.

criteria.name: Availability and next steps
criteria.acceptance_checks: Public discovery suppresses internal/legacy options and distinguishes live, assisted, gated and future capabilities.

criteria.name: Canonical catalog and shared services
criteria.acceptance_checks: Routes/UI reuse centralized module access, navigation and commercial contracts; exceptions are identified.

criteria.name: Ownership and domain separation
criteria.acceptance_checks: Representative tenant policies/services/models and provider lanes have explicit ownership without parallel mutations.

criteria.name: Documentation and release discipline
criteria.acceptance_checks: Current doc entry points, setup, CI migration/release guards and evidence versioning are coherent and reproducible.

criteria.name: Integration contract behavior
criteria.acceptance_checks: Synthetic mocked-provider tests cover signed events, failures, retries and disconnected/disabled state.

criteria.name: Live sandbox and recovery operations
criteria.acceptance_checks: Verified disposable merchant/store and mailbox sandbox, queue/retry visibility and backup evidence; actual provider acceptance.

criteria.name: Keyboard, labels and contrast
criteria.acceptance_checks: Public keyboard activation/dialog focus/escape, readable header links and labeled forms have browser evidence.

criteria.name: Responsive public surfaces
criteria.acceptance_checks: Phone 390px, tablet 820px, desktop 1440px checks for core public pages; no horizontal overflow or lost primary CTA.

criteria.name: Representative performance
criteria.acceptance_checks: Record repeatable local browser/Lighthouse timings for representative public routes and note limits; no invented production percentile.
